item.text:
The rebuilt surface is 40 m high, 8.4 m wide, and curves continuously to a 168° lip. About 10 m of the upper curve is above 160°, giving the whole car room to hang beneath it. The braced girders now follow the full hook and connect the overhang back to the towers.

The retuned default simulation climbs, holds nearly inverted for two seconds, and lands cleanly. I’m checking replay determinism and the failure modes against this geometry next.
